## Modules

- [Hammer](https://hammer.hexdocs.pm/Hammer.md): Hammer is a rate-limiting library for Elixir.
- [Hammer.Atomic](https://hammer.hexdocs.pm/Hammer.Atomic.md): A rate limiter implementation using Erlang's :atomics module for atomic counters.
- [Hammer.Atomic.FixWindow](https://hammer.hexdocs.pm/Hammer.Atomic.FixWindow.md): This module implements the Fix Window algorithm.
- [Hammer.Atomic.FixWindowPerKey](https://hammer.hexdocs.pm/Hammer.Atomic.FixWindowPerKey.md): This module implements a per-key fixed window rate-limiting algorithm using
Erlang's `:atomics` module for atomic counters.
- [Hammer.Atomic.LeakyBucket](https://hammer.hexdocs.pm/Hammer.Atomic.LeakyBucket.md): This module implements the Leaky Bucket algorithm.
- [Hammer.Atomic.TokenBucket](https://hammer.hexdocs.pm/Hammer.Atomic.TokenBucket.md): This module implements the Token Bucket algorithm.
The token bucket algorithm works by modeling a bucket that:
- Fills with tokens at a constant rate (the refill rate)
- Has a maximum capacity of tokens (the bucket size)
- Each request consumes one or more tokens
- If there are enough tokens, the request is allowed
- If not enough tokens, the request is denied
- [Hammer.ETS](https://hammer.hexdocs.pm/Hammer.ETS.md): An ETS backend for Hammer.
- [Hammer.ETS.FixWindow](https://hammer.hexdocs.pm/Hammer.ETS.FixWindow.md): This module implements the Fix Window algorithm.
- [Hammer.ETS.FixWindowPerKey](https://hammer.hexdocs.pm/Hammer.ETS.FixWindowPerKey.md): This module implements a per-key fixed window rate-limiting algorithm.
- [Hammer.ETS.LeakyBucket](https://hammer.hexdocs.pm/Hammer.ETS.LeakyBucket.md): This module implements the Leaky Bucket algorithm.
- [Hammer.ETS.SlidingWindow](https://hammer.hexdocs.pm/Hammer.ETS.SlidingWindow.md): This module implements the Rate Limiting Sliding Window algorithm.
- [Hammer.ETS.TokenBucket](https://hammer.hexdocs.pm/Hammer.ETS.TokenBucket.md): This module implements the Token Bucket algorithm.
The token bucket algorithm works by modeling a bucket that:
- Fills with tokens at a constant rate (the refill rate)
- Has a maximum capacity of tokens (the bucket size)
- Each request consumes one or more tokens
- If there are enough tokens, the request is allowed
- If not enough tokens, the request is denied
